title: Action Songs
text:
Action songs are fun songs for children. The children sing and move their bodies. They touch their head, their arms and their feet. Action songs are good for learning English.

One famous action song is Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. You sing the words and touch each part of the body. The song is fast. Children laugh and jump.

questions.text: What do the children do in action songs?
options: They sing and move their bodies

questions.text: What is the name of one famous action song?
Why do children probably remember the words of action songs well?
options: Because they do the actions while they sing
Because they read the words in a book
Because the songs are very long
Because they sing alone in a quiet room

questions.text: How does a child probably feel during an action song?

vocabulary.definition: to make music with your voice
to put your hand on something

paragraph_translations: Las canciones de acción son canciones divertidas para los niños. Los niños cantan y mueven su cuerpo. Tocan su cabeza, sus brazos y sus pies. Las canciones de acción son buenas para aprender inglés.
Una canción de acción famosa es Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. Tú cantas las palabras y tocas cada parte del cuerpo. La canción es rápida. Los niños ríen y saltan.
